question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information

given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All birds are omnivores.

All omnivores are lions.

Some birds are reptiles.

Conclusions:

(1) Some omnivores are reptiles.

(1) Some reptiles are lions
